这是 ENG 翻译Illustrious XL 的 ComfyUI 初学者工作流程由超级猫做1456。可能会发布更新并添加功能，也可能不会。现在，我只是想分享这个工作流程的原作者留下的JP笔记的翻译。

这是原始工作流程页面的描述：


更新：v1.0-vpred

o.en:
This is an ENG translation of theIllustrious XL's ComfyUI BeginnerWorkflow bysupercatdoing1456. Might release updates and add features, or I might not. For now, I just wanted to share the translation of the JP notes left by the original author of this workflow.

This is the description from the original workflow page:


UPDATE: v1.0-vpred

support v-pred model

  • NoobAI-XL (NAI-XL) V-pred test version

  • NoobAiIter_XL - vPred

Illustrious XL's ComfyUI Beginner Workflow

A very basic workflow for using illustrious XL (+Latent Hires.fix).
No custom nodes are used.

Please use this as a base for various extensions.
